versions.changelog:
Initial release of byted-security-llmscanner – a comprehensive management tool for large model security evaluation workflows.

- Supports creation and updating of model and agent evaluation assets.
- Enables querying of available resources, including models, agents, and agent platforms.
- Facilitates launching both compliance and security evaluation tasks.
- Provides commands for analyzing and reporting on task results.
- Includes detailed instructions, command usage examples, and troubleshooting tips.
